{{Recipe}}

This pasta salad made with orzo is brightly flavored, lemon-forward, and colorful—perfect for anything from the dinner table to the picnic blanket.

== Ingredients ==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] ground [[Cookbook:Turmeric|turmeric]]
* 1 pound dried [[Cookbook:Orzo|orzo]] pasta
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] drained pickled [[Cookbook:Caper|capers]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] juice
* ½ cup extra-virgin [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ¼ tsp ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* ½–1 cup fresh [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]], chopped
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Julienne|julienned]] [[Cookbook:Sun-dried Tomato|sundried tomatoes]]
* ½ cup chopped kalamata [[Cookbook:Olive|olives]]
* 8 ounces crumbled [[Cookbook:Feta Cheese|feta]] cheese

== Procedure ==

# Bring a large pot of water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] with the turmeric.
# Stir in the pasta, and boil until it is cooked to your taste.
# Drain the pasta in a [[Cookbook:Colander|colander]], and rinse briefly with cold water. Let drain.
# Combine the capers, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper and sugar in a jar. Seal the lid and shake well to combine and make the dressing.
# Transfer the drained orzo to a large bowl, and pour the dressing over the pasta. [[Cookbook:Tossing|Toss]] well to coat.
# Add the parsley, sundried tomatoes, olives, and feta. Toss to combine.
# Serve warm or at room temperature.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* This will keep well in the fridge. It is best when gently warmed back to room temperature before eating.
* The turmeric gives the orzo a yellow color and a mild flavor. It can be omitted, but it will be less bright.
